onboarding.title: Your first steps
onboarding.loadError: We could not load your confirmed choices. Check your connection and try again, or sign out.
onboarding.unconfirmed: Check your language and timezone, then confirm your intention. These choices are saved only when you confirm them.
onboarding.timezoneExample: Enter a timezone such as Europe/Warsaw. You can change the suggested value.
onboarding.intention: I want to be active regularly
onboarding.timezoneRequired: Enter a supported timezone, for example Europe/Warsaw, to continue.
onboarding.error_save: We could not confirm that your choices were saved. Your edits are still here. Try confirming again.
onboarding.error_timezone: This timezone was not accepted. Check it and confirm again.
onboarding.error_intention: Your intention was not accepted. Check your choice and confirm again.
onboarding.error_locale: This language was not accepted. Choose Polish or English and confirm again.
onboarding.error_load: We could not check whether your choices were saved. Try again to check before confirming another change.
onboarding.companionPending: Your first choices are saved. Your introduction to Zharomir is coming soon.
onboarding.notificationsPending: Your earlier choices are saved. Notification preferences will be available here soon.
onboarding.reviewPending: Your final review will be available here soon. No Oath has started.

auth.signInDescription: Sign in with Apple to begin your journey or return to your account.
auth.checkingApple: Checking whether Sign in with Apple is available…
auth.appleUnavailable: Sign in with Apple is unavailable on this device right now.
auth.verification_unavailable: We could not confirm your session. Check your connection and try again, or sign out.
auth.reauthenticate: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again to continue.
auth.freshChallenge: This sign-in attempt has expired or was already used. Sign in with Apple again to start a new attempt.
auth.rateLimited_one: Too many attempts. Wait {{count, number}} second before signing in again.
auth.rateLimited_other: Too many attempts. Wait {{count, number}} seconds before signing in again.
auth.configuration: Sign-in is not ready right now. Please try again later.
auth.loginUnavailable: We could not finish signing you in. Check your connection and start a new sign-in attempt.
auth.signOutPending: Sign-out is not yet confirmed by the server. Reconnect and try again to finish.
auth.cleanupTitle: One more step on this device
auth.cleanupConfirmed: The server has confirmed sign-out, but this device still needs to finish clearing the saved session. Try again.
auth.cleanupUnconfirmed: We could not safely read or update the saved session on this device. Sign-out is not yet complete. Try again before signing in.
auth.onboardingPending: Your first steps are coming soon.
auth.oathPending: Your first Oath will be available here. No Oath has started.
